name: TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Foundation (Level 1)
name_ja: TOGAF エンタープライズアーキテクチャ ファウンデーション

logistics.format: Computer-based multiple-choice exam at Pearson VUE or online proctored

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 2, introductory: 1. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: A recognized architecture framework and Japanese availability support an entry governance/design foundation; terminology-heavy multiple-choice testing and zero experience do not establish applied architecture practice.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recognized enterprise-architecture terminology and a proctored exam provide foundational framework knowledge. Zero experience and nontechnical multiple-choice coverage do not demonstrate security design delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded terminology-heavy architecture-framework exam requires no experience and has no technical-security scope. Global recognition does not move this conceptual introduction into practitioner security delivery.
